description: Inline is a work chat product for teams. It provides messaging, bots, and assistant-oriented integrations around conversations, spaces, and direct messages.
summary: inline.chat exposes a Bot HTTP API on api.inline.chat, a hosted OAuth-protected MCP server on mcp.inline.chat, a CLI, and owner-declared additional HTTP/Realtime surfaces; the Bot API and MCP are documented, while a second HTTP API is only owner-declared and not fully documented for developer auth.
